description: This file contains a test runner class for testing non-reentrant grain behaviors in Orleans, including various scenarios for deadlock detection and timeouts, with methods for different grain types and interleaving predicates.

classes.name: DisabledCallChainReentrancyTestRunner
classes.description: A test runner class for executing various non-reentrant grain tests in Orleans, including deadlock and timeout scenarios.

methods.name: NonReentrantGrain
methods.description: Tests a non-reentrant grain for deadlock or timeout behavior.

methods.name: NonReentrantGrain_WithMayInterleaveInstancedPredicate_WhenPredicateReturnsFalse
methods.description: Tests a grain with an instanced predicate for deadlock or timeout when the predicate returns false.

methods.name: UnorderedNonReentrantGrain
